newsitem.title: USA: Rexhall Industries sets five pct dividend.
newsitem.headline: Rexhall Industries sets five pct dividend.

text.p: Rexhall Industries Inc Tuesday said its board of directors had declared a five percent stock dividend to shareholders of record on May 12, with the dividend to be payable on May 26.
Without giving effect to the exercise of any outstanding options prior to the record date, the company said there were 2,630,030 shares of common stock outstanding.
It said the five percent stock dividend would create new shares, lifting the total to 2,761,532 shares outstanding at the record date.
Officials of the mobile home manufacturer could not immediately be reached for comment.

The company on April 15 reported a share loss of $0.18 for the fourth quarter ended December 31 versus a profit of $0.17 per share a year ago -- saying the results were largely the result of poor performance by its Indiana plant.
